post.description: Joins the OPEN aggregation of (organization, productId), or opens one with the first demand, under the aggregation’s row lock and the database clock read after it. The window is half-open, [openedAt, closesAt): a demand at or after closesAt never joins it — that same request ends the window (READY when it holds a demand and reaches its threshold; otherwise its snapshot’s policy: EXTEND moves it on and the demand joins it, REFER and CLOSE end it) and the demand joins the window that follows. productId is opaque and never checked against marketplace (Q-105, Q-120). DEMAND_SUBMITTED carries identifiers, the quantity and instants only — never the note. Closed by default (S-02). The buyer’s own organization only: a person holding a role PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_ROLES names (default PROCUREMENT_USER, ORGANIZATION_ADMIN) in the organization the request acts for. A demand or aggregation of any other organization, and one that does not exist, are both 404, never 403 (S-03). AUDITOR, the platform administrator (SYSTEM_ADMIN, whatever organization it selected) and a service token are refused (403) before anything is read. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` (docs/06 § 6.8): without one, or with one outside 8 to 255 characters, 400 VALIDATION_FAILED and nothing is done. The same key with the same body from the same user answers the original response and does nothing again; the same key with another body or user is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still being processed waits for its answer and past a few seconds is 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. The caller must be a signed-in person with a platform user id (403 otherwise).

parameters.description: Required, 8 to 255 characters. The same key with the same body from the same user returns the first response and does nothing again; with a different body or user, 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; while the first request is still in flight, 409 CONFLICT with Retry-After. Scoped to the organization, kept for PROCUREMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS (24 by default).

info.title: Rasta — Procurement Service
info.description: The procurement boundary (COM-007, ADR-070). An organization registers its needs — a quantity of a product, the product an opaque marketplace identifier that is never checked there (Q-105) — and each joins the one OPEN aggregation of (organization, product), or opens it. A window is open from its first demand for PROCUREMENT_AGGREGATION_WINDOW_HOURS (Q-10), half-open [openedAt, closesAt) by the database clock read after the aggregation’s lock: a demand at or after closesAt never joins it, and ends it instead — READY when it holds a demand and reaches its threshold (a quantity, never an amount), otherwise its snapshot’s shortfall policy: EXTEND, REFER (a fact only) or CLOSE — before joining the window that follows. Each aggregation keeps the settings it opened with. Aggregation never spans organizations (Q-119); only the buyer’s own organization reads or changes its demands, anyone else gets 404. Every change is an event on rasta.procurement.v1 — identifiers, quantities and instants, never a note, a reason or an amount — and so an audit record. RFQs, sealed quotations, evaluation and purchase orders follow (ADR-070 plan PRs 2 to 14); nothing here moves money.
